text:
The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand the concept described in the content, think of the Internet as a massive, chaotic city where every building is a website and every room inside those buildings is a web page. Without a map or a librarian, finding a specific room would be nearly impossible because there are billions of rooms. A search engine acts like a super-intelligent librarian who has memorized the location of every single room. When you ask for a specific topic, the librarian doesn't just guess; they consult a massive, constantly updated index (like a library catalog) to point you directly to the exact building and room that contains the information you need.
